decision_basis.thursday_actual: The 2026-07-30 HSC +1 validation lasted 97.5 minutes with Garmin load 182.1 and athlete-logged RPE 8.
decision_basis.original_friday_gate: The superseded chill ride required Thursday to remain at or below load 175 and RPE 7, with clean technical execution.
decision_basis.gate_result: Failed on both load and RPE. Pure Quill also contained a route-timing error and shortened route, so a next-day HSC comparison would be confounded by fatigue and day order.
decision_basis.density: The last seven days contain 442.7 minutes and Garmin load 656.7 across five activities, including two meaningful MTB sessions plus a 93.8-minute hike.
decision_basis.calendar: Saturday is a full church day and Sunday remains Sabbath.

supersedes.title: Stumpjumper HSC softer-setting chill compliance ride
supersedes.reason: Its explicit Thursday eligibility ceiling was exceeded.

session.title: Friday absorption day after HSC +1 validation
session.purpose: Absorb Thursday's meaningful physiological and neural cost, protect the positive HSC +1 learning, and avoid contaminating the next setup comparison with next-day fatigue.

dose.daily_life: Normal low-stress daily movement only; no manufactured recovery workout or frequency-padding bike file.
dose.mechanical: If convenient, perform a non-riding Stumpjumper inspection and record cold tyre pressures, fork O-ring travel, rebound position, and any leak, play, or pressure loss.
dose.recovery: Eat normally with adequate carbohydrate and protein, replace fluid and sodium to thirst and sweat loss, and prioritize an earlier sleep opportunity.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A no-load day allows the high-quality rider-position and front-support pattern to consolidate while lowering residual leg, upper-body, and CNS cost before the church commitment and Sabbath.
execution_rules: Do not convert good morning readiness into a bike, run, gym, interval, or setup-test session.
Do not return HSC one click softer for a next-day comparison; retain HSC +1 as the provisional attack setting until a clean same-route validation can be scheduled.
Normal walking and ordinary daily activity are not restricted.

expected_result.physiology: Legs and systemic stress stabilize or improve without adding training load.
expected_result.technical: No additional setup variable is introduced; Thursday's evidence remains interpretable.
expected_result.week: Saturday church and Sunday Sabbath remain protected, with the next bike-specific build beginning from recovered evidence.

stop_rules: No readiness metric upgrades this rest prescription into training.
Any illness, pain, unusual fatigue, or poor overnight response increases recovery attention but does not create a compensatory workout.
